note: Sheet status: Demo paid (50% of 75%), 1 point; no flow deck. The Revival Details form has a Revival Reason dropdown (required) and a Remark textarea (optional, max 200 characters), and both values are sent to the API on revive. The reason list comes from ocms_suspension_reason (type RV, source OCMS, active); that table content is DB data with no seed SQL in the repo, so which reason codes exist cannot be verified from repo. A comment at TemporaryRevivalHelper.java:114 says 50 characters, but the code (UI and server) limits to 200; the code is what runs. No maintenance ticket changes these steps.
recommendation: Can be claimed in full based on code. The revival reason list in the DB should be confirmed in UAT (not visible from the repo).

steps.step: The Revival Details form offers a Revival Reason dropdown
steps.detail: When the form opens, setOptions loads REVIVAL_REASON with suspensionSource = 'OCMS' and active status (RevivalDetails.tsx:39-47; constant.ts:3). CB_REVIVAL_REASON POSTs suspensionreasonlist with suspensionType = 'RV' (OptionsContext.tsx:280-291,316-319), and the dropdown shows code + description (OptionsContext.tsx:294-299; RevivalDetails.tsx:64-80). The ocms_suspension_reason content is DB data with no seed SQL in the repo: which reason codes exist cannot be verified from repo.

steps.step: A revival reason must be filled in before revival can continue
steps.detail: The yup validation makes the 'reason' field required (Revival.ts:18,25-27; wired in Revival.tsx:128-129). The Proceed button runs validate() and, on failure, shows the alert 'Failed to proceed REVIVAL. Please check your form.' then focuses the faulty field (RevivalForm.tsx:69-84). The server re-checks: an empty reason is rejected (RevivalBaseHelper.java:121-123) and the code must exist in the active RV list for source OCMS from the DB (RevivalBaseHelper.java:86-97,175-183); if reading the list fails, an empty set is used so every code is rejected (fail-closed).

steps.step: Special remarks are optional free text up to 200 characters
steps.detail: The 'remark' TextAreaInput has no required rule, length=200 and a remaining-characters counter (RevivalDetails.tsx:83-91). The server rejects remarks over 200 characters at the staff-revive-suspension endpoint (SuspensionProcessingController.java:639-643) and in the helper (RevivalBaseHelper.java:139-145). The comment at TemporaryRevivalHelper.java:114 says 50 characters but the code uses 200; the limit in the original spec cannot be verified from repo.

steps.step: The entered reason and remarks are sent to the revival together with the logged-in officer ID
steps.detail: ReviveDataMapping builds the payload {noticeNo[], suspensionType, revivalReason, revivalRemarks, officerAuthorisingRevival = user.userId} from the form values (Revival.ts:17-23), used for both the PS and TS requests (RevivalForm.tsx:109-117,137-145). On the server these values are written to the suspended_notice rows as revival_reason, revival_remarks and officer_authorising_revival (RevivalBaseHelper.java:278-299).
